jokes: Route 347 update: still under construction. Historians believe the first cone was placed by the Culper Ring.
347 eastbound: moving at the speed of a Stony Brook Village scarecrow.
Breaking: a driver on 347 reports seeing actual pavement. Officials are investigating.
347 at Nicolls Road: allow 10 minutes, or one full season of fall foliage.
Good news: the merge on 347 is complete. Bad news: it has merged with your weekend plans.
